asset.name: CheckpointCard
asset.description: The resumable milestone recording completed work, produced artifacts, captured state, remaining tasks, and the actions to continue or restore from that point.

requires.reason: Framing uses the shared card, which is a genuinely bounded object here.
Timestamps render and update through the shared component.
Certainty and urgency are expressed on the shared orthogonal axes rather than as one flat variant set.
Produced outputs render through the shared artifact component.
